what: Two server pause points in email verification (POST /verify/start and POST /verify/complete), each asking the stack's gate service whether to go on: a code request after it read the verification in progress and passed the 60 s resend gap, before it stores a new code and mails it; and a code attempt after it read the verification and its attempt count and passed the expiry and five-attempt checks, before it compares the code and counts a wrong guess. For deterministic interleavings of concurrent requests by one account: C19 (S22, more than five guesses evaluated; S23, more than one code mailed). Its own helper (functions/src/lib/e2eIdentityGate.ts), so it applies alone or beside the other amplify sets

gates.name: verify-start-after-read
gates.where: functions/src/index.ts verifyEmail, action start: after users/{uid}.verification is read and the resend gap check passed, before the new verification is written and the code mailed

gates.name: verify-complete-after-read
gates.where: functions/src/index.ts verifyEmail, action complete: after users/{uid}.verification is read and its expiry and attempt checks passed, before the code is compared and a wrong guess's attempt written
